title: Polar clock-wipe and bow-tie sweep
blurb: One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas wipes between two live HTML cards with a single hand, bow-tie blades or a quad iris behind a refracting glass leading arm. Scrub around the centre dial or press Sweep while buttons and text fields in both scenes stay clickable.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas wipe between two live HTML scenes in polar coordinates with single-hand, bow-tie and quad-iris blades, prism glass refraction on the leading arm, and sector-aware updateElementGeometry() hit testing?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160.0.8188.0 canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass on one ElementGL context (0.98 MP, 7.8 MB), readPixels() confirms 90°, 270° and bow-tie quadrant splits plus luminous arm peaks (255), and sector-aware updateElementGeometry() keeps both scenes clickable mid-sweep. Android Chrome 159 and check:jank stay not verified.
